summary.en: OK Computer-era set on the UK festival main stage. Art-rock that holds a large muddy field.
summary.zh: OK Computer 时期站上英国音乐节主舞台。艺术摇滚撑住大片泥地。

whyEpic.en: 1997 Glastonbury is often cited as proof that UK alternative could headliner-scale without classic stadium moves. Paranoid Android runs long; the crowd stays. The set links OK Computer to festival memory.
whyEpic.zh: 1997 格拉斯顿伯里常被引用为：英国 alternative 能做主打规模，而不靠传统体育馆套路。Paranoid Android 拉长，人群不走。这场把 OK Computer 焊进音乐节记忆。

rightsNote.en: No full embeds. Prefer BBC/official licensed archives.
rightsNote.zh: 不嵌整场。优先 BBC/官方授权存档。
